faq.question: What is the purity of Semaglutide?
faq.answer: ≥99% by HPLC with ESI-MS confirmation. C18 fatty diacid linker integrity verified. Batch-specific COA included.

faq.question: What is the molecular weight of Semaglutide?
faq.answer: ~4,113.6 Da. The C18 fatty diacid linker at Lys26 is critical for albumin binding and extended half-life.

faq.question: How does Semaglutide differ from Tirzepatide?
faq.answer: Semaglutide is a single GLP-1 receptor agonist. Tirzepatide is a dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist with enhanced metabolic effects. See our GLP-1 Buyer's Guide for full comparison.

faq.question: What kit configurations are available?
faq.answer: Standard: 10mg × 10 vials. Also 5mg × 10 vials for evaluation orders. Custom configurations available for bulk wholesale orders.

faq.question: How should Semaglutide be stored?
faq.answer: Lyophilized: 2-8°C, protected from light, 24-month stability. Reconstituted: aliquot at -20°C for up to 30 days. Do not refreeze.

faq.question: What is the difference between Semaglutide sodium and Semaglutide acetate?
faq.answer: Different salt forms of the same peptide sequence. Sodium salt is produced by neutralizing TFA with NaOH; acetate by counterion exchange with acetic acid. Our standard is the sodium salt unless otherwise specified. Specify your salt form requirement in your inquiry.

faq.question: Why is Semaglutide less soluble in pure water?
faq.answer: The C18 fatty diacid linker (lipidated side chain) makes Semaglutide more hydrophobic than non-lipidated peptides. Use phosphate buffer (pH 7.0–7.4) for reconstitution. Gentle vortexing may be needed — do not sonicate or heat, which can degrade the peptide or linker.

faq.question: How do you verify the fatty acid linker is intact?
faq.answer: Standard HPLC (UV 214 nm) detects the peptide backbone but may not distinguish intact vs. degraded linker. For bulk orders we offer HPLC-ELSD or LC-MS/MS which specifically confirms intact lipidated peptide molecular weight.

faq.question: Do you offer Cagrilintide + Semaglutide as a stack?
faq.answer: Yes — a standard pre-formulated specialty stack combining GLP-1 and amylin receptor agonism for dual-pathway metabolic research. Ships with combined COA. See Specialty Stacks or contact us.
